data.heading: Concrete Sealing & Staining in Boise, ID
data.subheading: The Bench's aging 1940s concrete and new Harris Ranch driveways both face Boise freeze-thaw. We seal and stain to guard against cracks, stains, and spalling.

data.body:
Older Bench concrete is already tired. Much of the Bench went in during the 1940s and 1950s, and that concrete has seen decades of freeze-thaw. Around Depot Bench, South Boise Village and Morris Hill you see cracking and surface spalling from years of moisture cycling. Cleaning and sealing slows the damage and protects what is left.

New slabs are worth protecting from day one. Driveways in Harris Ranch and Barber Valley look great now, but Boise winters and hard summer sun will test them. Sealing early helps a new slab resist staining and freeze-thaw before any of it starts.

Staining is where the curb appeal comes in. A tired Bench patio or a blank new driveway can take decorative color that suits the house. Stain plus seal gives you a surface that looks finished and stands up to the seasons.
